dataList.name: Tangled Black Thread
dataList.desc: The effects of this unit's Skills, Low Morale, и Panic наносит [TangleBlackYarn] on the enemy ※ [TangleBlackYarn] can be reduced either на using Defense Skills или via certain Skills of this unit при получении удара, активирует следующие эффекты: - Получает 1 [SickBlackYarn] - Если скилл, что ударил this unit is a Slash Skill, получает 1 дополнительный [SickBlackYarn] - Если скилл, что ударил this unit есть 5+ Вес атаки, получает [HeavyBlackYarn] на следующий ход (один раз за ход)
dataList.flavor: The black thread wound around its body was not there before. на sheer fortune, когда the previous age gave way to the next, those threads coiled around the body of the thing of eld. Wrapped in thread, it survived в the Age of the Department Store. Now, those black threads begin to come undone.

dataList.name: Into the Waters of Eld
dataList.desc: Если a Part becomes Staggered, Убирает 1 Stagger Threshold from other Parts и end the turn; затем,все части получают [HideBlackYarn] на следующий ход Если [HideBlackYarn] expired due to being hit, - Получает 10 [SickBlackYarn] - Если [SickBlackYarn] was gained beyond its макс. cap, получает 3 Fragile в этом ходу и на следующий ход Конец хода: Если [HideBlackYarn] expired, - Получает (7 - remaining Potency) [SickBlackYarn] - Получает 1 [AngryBlackYarn] на следующий ход
dataList.flavor: Into the embrace of the sea from a bygone age, where один раз it swam as naturally и freely as could be.

Начало битвы: Хилит макс. ХП и 45 IQ

dataList.name: Alteration
dataList.desc: Начало хода: Наносит 1 [TailoringTarget] on the Sinner that dealt the most урона этому юниту last turn и использует скилл "Patterning" - Если the [TailoringTarget] Sinner есть 9 [ScissorsMark], активирует "Patterning" as "Surfile à la Chaîne" вместо этого Every time this unit is hit на a Sinner, - Наносит 1 [ScissorsMark] on the said Sinner (макс. 5 per turn per Sinner) - получает +1 счётчик [ChargeKhaki] (макс. 5 per turn per Sinner) Получает 3 [ResultEnhancement] every time this unit is hit на a Sinner that есть [TailoringTarget] (макс. 9 per turn)
dataList.flavor:
They say a garment is only truly finished through alteration. Unless it was made to measure, it есть to be adjusted until it fits the wearer.

And that is not true of clothing alone. Whatever is taken in from the outside must first be altered to suit oneself before it can be worn, lived in, и made to fit the heart.

dataList.name: Tailoring
dataList.desc: При Начало битвы или при the start of the turn this unit recovered from Stagger, получает 30 [FinishedFabric] Накладывает the [PanicChangeLock] effect Конец хода: Если этот юнит находится в Panic, change IQ у 30 Начало хода: - получает щит равный ([FinishedFabric] стаков)% ХП (макс. 30%) - Хилит IQ равный [FinishedFabric] стаков
dataList.flavor:
Cutting means shaping fabric to a pattern. Cutting gives a garment its form, while alteration makes it wearable.

To fabric, затем, cutting itself is a form of alteration. один раз cut, the fabric takes on a shape that reflects its own properties, becoming the garment the cutter intended.

dataList.name: Scissors That Do Not Rest
dataList.desc: Every time Annette the Alterationist is hit на a Sinner, Поднимает порог стаггера на число 0.8% ХП Если this unit is Staggered, теряет все Shield, [FinishedFabric], и [LargeTailoringShears]; затем, получает 3 [Vulnerable] Начало хода: При 60% или less ХП, - Получает 1 [ResultEnhancement] и 1 [SlashDamageUp] за каждые 20% недостающего ХП (макс. 3 respectively) - Convert the final Coin of "Trimming" и Coin 2 of "Cutting" to [SuperCoin]
dataList.flavor:
A body whose very worth was shaped на the work of alteration goes on cutting without end, driven to alter и tailor forever.

Even as the body breaks apart, she cannot bring herself to stop altering и cutting. She is made to cut things away, yet cannot cut herself free.

dataList.desc: Начало хода: Когда there are 2 или fewer Tanned Prisoners на поле, получает дополнительный Slot Конец хода: Получает 1 [AttackDmgUp] на следующий ход за каждые Tanned Prisoner на поле

dataList.flavor:
Demand есть gone through the roof, while raw hides have only grown harder to come by. The hide of the original sinners was один раз the sort nobody would so much as glance при. Then one season changed everything: demand surged, prices soared, и what used to be sold for scraps или simply thrown away became coveted material.

Now even the blemishes on its surface are dressed up as character и sold as part of the appeal.

dataList.name: Unending, Unavoidable Stream of Customer Complaints
dataList.desc:
"Cry of the Cocoon" is heard every "multiple of 3" turns
Upon entering Phase 2, "Cry of the Cocoon" continues to be heard каждый ход

This unit cannot be immobilized in the turn "Cry of the Cocoon" is heard

Если ХП этого юнита is brought past its Stagger Threshold, получает 2 [Vulnerable] на следующий ход
dataList.flavor:
Voices seep from the cocoon.

"Anything under 80-count two-ply? Not even fabric!"
"Why aren't the buttonholes horizontal?"
"Jersey knit on machine? Really?"
"Why isn't the selvage red?"
"This hasn't even been shrink-proofed."
"Anything below Super 150 is cheap cloth, obviously."
"You think the Super scale is just yarn thickness? Diameter и yarn count aren't even the same thing. Don't you know that?"
"You're finishing the hem with a Union Special, right? Of course you are!"
"Is this Rigid? ... Oh. Selvage?"
"Wait... the stitch-per-inch count is way too even. You used a machine, didn't you?"
"It's not bespoke если it's not hand-stitched."
"... That's not even a Milanese buttonhole."
"Shirting needs to be over 200-count."
"Ugh, I can see the stitching on the outside."
"There, I can see two rows of stitching there. Rejected."
"What's with this seam finish?"
"Three-ply, minimum."
